tuples.claim_text: Transformer 使用多头自注意力机制。
tuples.ref_text_excerpt: We rely entirely on multi-head self-attention, dispensing with recurrence.

tuples.claim_text: 该模型在 WMT14 英德翻译上取得 28.4 BLEU。

tuples.ref_text_excerpt: We trained on 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs

tuples.claim_text: 残差连接（residual connection）有助于深层网络训练。
tuples.ref_text_excerpt: residual connections ease training of deep networks

tuples.ref_text_excerpt: We propose the Transformer, a new architecture based solely on attention.
